Name: George and Evelyn Developed
Author: Cakeguru
Description:
The old couple of Stardew Valley, George and Evelyn, were always two of my favorite characters from the get-go. Unfortunately I found their dialogue to be very repetitive due to the fact there wasn't much of it. So I took it upon myself to solve the problem and try to give these two wrinkled old prunes the depth they deserve. 

Thus was created this mod, George & Evelyn Developed, which features:

-Dozens of new lines each, for each season and every heart level
-A bit of info on the character's youth and how things were back in their day
-Sage wisdom in the form of farming tips
-Grumbling about the weather
-Talking about their favorite grandson more
-Six new recipes! One is from George and five are from Evelyn. All of them give you sweet buffs.

UPDATE 1.1
-32 new lines each for George and Evelyn, 64 total
-Six new recipes! You'll need 10 hearts with George for his, 10 with Evelyn for four of hers, and 10 with both for Evelyn's fifth special recipe. Note that these recipes can only be mailed in and after year 2
-Now requires JsonAssets and MailFrameworkMod, optional dialogue-only file if you want a lite version of the mod

Installation:
Download and unzip the main file into your Mods folder within the Stardew Valley directory and enjoy!

Requirements:
SMAPI
ContentPatcher
JsonAssets
MailFrameworkMod

Upcoming:
Events
Make Dusty a mobile character
